metadata.based_on: MAIB Report 7/2018 - Huayang Endeavour / Seafrontier Collision, 1 July 2017
metadata.description: Overtaking situation in Dover Strait TSS where conflicting VHF communication leads to collision. Agent vessel (faster) must safely overtake slower vessel ahead while third vessel crosses ahead of target.
learning_objectives: Rule 13 - Overtaking: Overtaking vessel must keep clear
Rule 16 - Action by give-way vessel: Take early substantial action
Rule 34 - Sound signals: Use appropriate signals when manoeuvring
VHF communication hazards in collision avoidance
Long-range scanning and early action requirement (Rule 7b)
metadata.key_lesson: VHF should not be relied upon for collision avoidance. Early, substantial course alterations with appropriate sound signals are required. The overtaking vessel is ALWAYS give-way regardless of any VHF 'agreement'.

vessel_details.notes: Faster vessel overtaking from astern. COG approximately 222 degrees. Must keep clear under Rule 13.
Slower vessel ahead on similar course (221 degrees). Stand-on vessel under Rule 13. May alter course to port to avoid crossing vessel.
Crossing vessel ahead of Seafrontier on COG 207 degrees. Creates traffic complexity requiring Seafrontier to consider course alteration.

scenario_context.location: Dover Strait Traffic Separation Scheme, South-West lane
scenario_context.weather: Clear, Wind SW Force 5, Slight seas
scenario_context.critical_decision_point: Agent vessel approaching target from astern at 1nm range, CPA less than 0.3nm predicted
